name: Dutyline
summary: A fictional maintenance-control log. Sample data for a tool that is not in the sample issue.
paragraphs: Dutyline, in this sample, drafts the shift handoff from defects, MEL items, and parts calls a controller already logged. The listing exists so the directory is not only the tools named in one issue.
A real handoff tool would need the operator's control manual, and a person would still approve every note. This page does not offer that product.
whyItMatters: A missed defect at shift change is work the next crew starts late. A clean handoff can return those hours to the aircraft instead of the log.
pricing: Sample pricing, not a live offer.
bestFor: Readers comparing a directory page with the issue archive.
